paragraphs: R' Yehoshua bar Nachman — Nachmani. See the entry R' Yehoshua bar Nechemiah.[^1]

notes.text: Nachman and Nachmani are heading alternatives, while the connected target has Nechemiah. Earlier machine OCR had גחמן/גחמני; those are not verified printed alternatives. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
